Uncle Lim Ep.10: One Message, Twelve Bitter Gourds

Everything you need to post this episode: blog, search meta, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook and Instagram, Google Business and WhatsApp. Work down the checklist in order.

Video: Uncle_Lim_Ep10_Video.mp4 · 9:16 · ~40sUncle_Lim_Ep10_Video_GBP30.mp4Theme: Checking forwarded health messages before trying themOutlet: KSL City Mall

Post in this order

  1. Blog postPublish first to get the link
  2. YouTube ShortsAdd blog link in description
  3. TikTokTurn on AI-generated label
  4. Facebook + Instagram ReelsOne caption for both
  5. Google Business postImage + text + button
  6. WhatsApp broadcastLast, with all links
Compliance check before postingMASA: no scheduled condition named anywhere; the forwarded juice is never linked to any condition or benefit; no claim words; no numeric readings. Google Business: Update post, no phone, links, hashtags or caps, no calls to purchase. Uncle Ong and the kakis are fictional. Pharmacist Aaron (real staff character) only asks a question and never diagnoses. Flag for Yeoh: the story shows a home remedy (bitter gourd and garlic juice) being questioned, not endorsed; a quick compliance glance is advised since the topic touches herbal remedies.

Step 5

Google Business Profile post

Google Search your outlet name → Add update → upload the image → paste the text → add a button. Never type phone numbers, links or hashtags in the text: Google removes those posts.

Post text
Got a forwarded health message? Show our pharmacist before you try it. 📱 In Episode 10 of our Uncle Lim family story, Uncle Lim's kopitiam friends add him to their group chat. By breakfast there are forty messages, and one of them describes a secret morning juice. By noon he has twelve bitter gourds in the kitchen. At the kopitiam the next day, our pharmacist asks him one simple question: who actually wrote this message? Three quick checks before you try anything from a group chat: Find the author. No name means you cannot check it. Think about the medicines you already take. Ask a pharmacist, and keep your doctor's plan first. Bring the message on your phone for a Minute Consult at Alpro Pharmacy KSL City Mall, no appointment needed. Ground Floor, Lot G-001, KSL City Mall, Taman Abad, Johor Bahru. Open daily, 10AM to 10PM.
